# Widget fences

<!-- Generated by ui/scripts/emit-fence-schemas.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every picture in a KiwiFS page is data, not a program. You write a fenced block
with a YAML body; KiwiFS validates it on write, renders it interactively, steps it
on a clock a reader can link to, and degrades to readable text in `cat`, git, PDF
and search.

## Body grammar

Top-level keys are the widget's properties. An optional `steps:` list holds one
shallow patch per step, **each over the previous step**, so you write only what
changes. `frames:` is the same list with each entry over the base instead.

A step may also carry keys that are not widget properties:

| Step key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `note` | Prose shown under the picture for this step. |
| `line` / `next` | 1-based line of `code:` to highlight. |
| `label` | Name for this step in the transport. |
| `why` | Key → explanation, revealed when the reader selects that part. |
| `breakpoint` | Auto-play pauses here. |
| `duration` | Milliseconds this step holds at 1×. |
| `expect` | Pause until the reader selects the right part. |

`code:` plus `lang:` render a listing that steps in lockstep. `props:` is the
escape hatch for a widget property whose name collides with a reserved key.

## Meta string

Written after the language on the opening line:

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id=name` | Names the widget, its anchor, and its clock. |
| `clock=name` | Shares a step counter with every other fence naming it. |
| `caption="…"` | Caption under the figure. |
| `title="…"` | Heading above it. |
| `width=wide\|full` | Figure width. |
| `autoplay`, `loop` | Playback behaviour. |

A reader links to a step as `#?step.<id>=N`; the first unnamed widget on a page
owns the bare `#?step=N`.

## Naming and collisions

Each fence answers to three language tags: the bare name (`array`), the explicit
`kiwi-array`, and the legacy `widget:array`. A bare name only claims a block whose
YAML parses to a mapping carrying one of the fence's marker keys, so a vault that
already uses `tree` for directory listings keeps its code blocks. The `kiwi-` and
`widget:` spellings always render, or report an error, for authors who prefer
strictness.

`[ui] typed_fences = false` in `.kiwi/config.toml` turns bare tags off for a
workspace; `typed_fence_tags = ["array", "matrix"]` allows only those.

## Fences

| Fence | What it draws |
|---|---|
| [`array`](#array) | One or more arrays on a shared index axis, with pointers, dependency arrows and span brackets. |
| [`bars`](#bars) | Columns in value space: histograms, trapping rain water, largest rectangle, sorting passes, latency distributions. |
| [`bits`](#bits) | A value as labelled bits: bitmask DP, flag registers, permission sets, two's complement, IEEE-754 layouts. |
| [`graph`](#graph) | Nodes and edges: algorithm graphs, service architecture, state machines, dependency DAGs. Edge keys are `"from->to"` or an explicit `id`. |
| [`kiwi-steps`](#kiwi-steps) | A mermaid diagram walked one step at a time: focus and dim nodes, reveal sequence messages, highlight code in lockstep. |
| [`list`](#list) | A linked list: reversal, cycle detection, LRU chains, random pointers. A numeric `next` is how you draw a cycle back into the middle. |
| [`map`](#map) | Hash slots, chains and probe paths: hash tables, caches, symbol tables, routing tables, or a plain unordered dictionary. |
| [`matrix`](#matrix) | An index-addressed table: DP tables, grids, adjacency matrices, confusion matrices. Cells take `[r, c]` or `"r,c"`. |
| [`numberline`](#numberline) | A single value axis: inequalities, interval arithmetic, binary-search-on-answer buckets, SLO thresholds. Closed endpoints are filled, open ones hollow. |
| [`plane`](#plane) | A coordinate plane in data units: geometry, sweep lines, hulls, vectors, tile maps. Draws what it is given — the algorithm stays in the steps. |
| [`plot`](#plot) | An x–y plot: complexity curves, predicate curves for binary search on the answer, latency against load, convergence. |
| [`queue`](#queue) | FIFO: BFS frontiers, work queues, sliding windows. `layout: ring` shows a circular buffer, where front and back crossing the end is the point. |
| [`sequence`](#sequence) | A message sequence between participants: API flows, consensus rounds, handshakes, retries. Steps reveal one message at a time. |
| [`stack`](#stack) | A LIFO stack: monotonic stacks, bracket matching, call stacks, undo histories. |
| [`table`](#table) | A named-column table: relations, schemas, lock tables, Bayes 2×2, MVCC row versions. Cells are addressed `"rowKey.colKey"`. |
| [`timeline`](#timeline) | Spans on a shared axis with named lanes and causal arrows: scheduling, lock handoffs, happens-before, isolation anomalies, log spans. |
| [`tree`](#tree) | Binary, n-ary and keyed trees: BSTs, tries, recursion trees, heaps (`fromArray`), union-find forests (`parents`), B-tree pages (`keys`). |

### array

One or more arrays on a shared index axis, with pointers, dependency arrows and span brackets.

A bare `array` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `values` or `rows`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-array`, `widget:array`, `arraystack`, `kiwi-arraystack`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIndex` | `array` or `number` or `string` | The cell being written this step. |
| `activeIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Cells being written this step. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `arrows` | `array` of `object` | Dependency arcs within the row: `{from, to, label?, dashed?, side?}`. |
| `arrowsBetweenRows` | `array` of `object` | With `rows:`: arrows between rows, `{from: [row, index], to: [row, index], label?}`. |
| `cellColors` | `array` | Base color per cell, matching the same items in a tree or graph. |
| `cellSize` | `number` | Cell size in px. Defaults to 48, shrinking for long arrays. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Done / greyed-out cells. |
| `empty` | `array` of `string` | Strings that render as unfilled slots, e.g. `["."]`. |
| `flash` | `boolean` | Pulse cells whose value changed since the previous step. Default true. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary highlight, e.g. the current window. |
| `indexBase` | `number` | First index number. Default 0. — fixed across steps |
| `indexLabels` | `array` | Index captions instead of 0..n-1 — characters, amounts, `∅`. |
| `label` | `string` | Row title in the left gutter, e.g. `nums` or `dp`. |
| `labelWidth` | `number` | Width of the row-label gutter in px. — fixed across steps |
| `offset` | `number` | Blank cells before the first value, to line this row up under another. |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Named pointers above or below cells: `{index, label, color?, side?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `ranges` | `array` of `object` | Brackets over spans: `{start, end, label?, color?, side?}`. |
| `readColor` | `string` | Color of cells read by the active cell. — fixed across steps |
| `readIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Cells the active cell reads from — `dp[i-1]`, `dp[c-w]`. |
| `rowGap` | `number` | Vertical gap between rows in px. Default 2, or 36 when arrows are drawn. — fixed across steps |
| `rows` | `array` of `object` | Several rows sharing one index axis. Each entry takes the single-row keys above. |
| `showIndices` | `boolean` or `string` | Show the index row. With `rows:`: true, false, "last" (default) or "all". |
| `sublabels` | `array` | Caption under each value — a choice arrow ↖ ↑ ←, a parent pointer. |
| `tooltips` | `array` | Hover text per cell. |
| `values` | `array` or `string` | Cell values. `null` is an unfilled slot; ±Infinity shows ∞; a string is split into characters. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | Wrap long arrays onto more lines instead of scrolling. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```array id=two-sum caption="Two-pointer sweep on a sorted array"
values: [2, 7, 11, 15, 19]
pointers:
  - {index: 0, label: lo}
  - {index: 4, label: hi}
steps:
  - note: "2 + 19 = 21 > 9 — move hi left"
    activeIndices: [0, 4]
    line: 3
  - note: "2 + 15 = 17 > 9 — move hi left"
    pointers: [{index: 0, label: lo}, {index: 3, label: hi}]
    activeIndices: [0, 3]
  - note: "2 + 7 = 9 — found it"
    pointers: [{index: 0, label: lo}, {index: 1, label: hi}]
    activeIndices: [0, 1]
    breakpoint: true
code: |
  lo, hi = 0, len(a) - 1
  while lo < hi:
      s = a[lo] + a[hi]
      if s == target: return lo, hi
      if s > target: hi -= 1
      else: lo += 1
lang: python
```
````

### bars

Columns in value space: histograms, trapping rain water, largest rectangle, sorting passes, latency distributions.

A bare `bars` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `values`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-bars`, `widget:bars`, `histogram`, `barchart`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `values` | `array` of `number` | Bar heights. Negatives draw below a zero baseline. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Emphasised columns. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `barColors` | `array` | Per-bar fill override. |
| `barWidth` | `number` | Bar width, px. Default 40. — fixed across steps |
| `chartHeight` | `number` | Plot height, px. Default 220. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed or eliminated columns. |
| `gap` | `number` | Gap between bars, px. Default 10. — fixed across steps |
| `guides` | `array` of `object` | Horizontal reference lines: `{value, label?, color?}` — a water level, an SLO. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted columns. |
| `labels` | `array` | Labels under each bar. Defaults to the index; `null` hides one. |
| `maxValue` | `number` | Top of the value axis. |
| `minValue` | `number` | Bottom of the value axis. |
| `overlays` | `array` of `object` | Value-space rectangles: `{startIndex, endIndex?, fromValue?, toValue, label?}` — a water fill, a chosen rectangle. |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Named pointers above columns: `{index, label, color?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `valueLabels` | `boolean` or `array` | Value labels on the bar tips: true (default), false, or custom text per bar. |

````markdown
```bars id=rain caption="Trapping rain water"
values: [0, 1, 0, 2, 1, 0, 1, 3, 2, 1, 2, 1]
steps:
  - note: "Water sits wherever both sides are higher"
    overlays: [{startIndex: 2, toValue: 1, label: "1"}]
    activeIndices: [1, 3]
  - note: "The big basin between 3 and 7 holds four units"
    overlays:
      - {startIndex: 2, toValue: 1}
      - {startIndex: 4, endIndex: 6, toValue: 2, label: "4"}
    activeIndices: [3, 7]
  - note: "Total: 6"
    overlays:
      - {startIndex: 2, toValue: 1}
      - {startIndex: 4, endIndex: 6, toValue: 2}
      - {startIndex: 9, toValue: 2, label: "1"}
```
````

### bits

A value as labelled bits: bitmask DP, flag registers, permission sets, two's complement, IEEE-754 layouts.

A bare `bits` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `value`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-bits`, `widget:bits`, `bitmask`, `kiwi-bits`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number` | The value to show. — **required** |
| `activeBits` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Bit positions being set or tested this step. |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `arrows` | `array` of `object` | Arcs between bit positions: `{from, to, label?, dashed?}`. |
| `bits` | `number` | How many bits to draw. Defaults to the value's bit length. — fixed across steps |
| `cellSize` | `number` | Cell size, px. — fixed across steps |
| `decode` | `uint` or `int` or `twos` or `ieee32` or `ieee64` or `hex` or `oct` or `raw` | How to read the pattern in the summary row. A list shows several readings at once. Default uint. |
| `fields` | `array` of `object` | Named bit ranges drawn as brackets under the row: `{from, to, label, color?}` — a float's sign, exponent and mantissa; a flags register; a packed struct. Each bracket shows the field's value. |
| `highlightBits` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted bit positions. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `label` | `string` | Row title, e.g. `mask`. |
| `labels` | `array` | What each bit stands for, indexed by bit position (bit 0 = least significant). |
| `lsbFirst` | `boolean` | Draw bit 0 on the left. Default false (most significant first). — fixed across steps |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Pointers by bit position: `{bit, label, color?, side?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `readBits` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Bit positions read by this step. |
| `showSummary` | `boolean` | Show the decimal value and popcount beside the bits. Default true. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```bits id=subsets caption="Bitmask DP: visiting city 2"
bits: 4
labels: [A, B, C, D]
steps:
  - note: "Start at A only"
    value: 1
    activeBits: [0]
  - note: "Add C to the visited set"
    value: 5
    activeBits: [2]
    readBits: [0]
  - note: "All four visited — the subproblem is complete"
    value: 15
    activeBits: [1, 3]
```
````

### graph

Nodes and edges: algorithm graphs, service architecture, state machines, dependency DAGs. Edge keys are `"from->to"` or an explicit `id`.

A bare `graph` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `nodes`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-graph`, `widget:graph`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `array` of `object` | `{id, label?, sublabel?, shape?, x?, y?, color?, group?}`. Omit x/y to have the layout place the node. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeEdges` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Edge keys (`"from->to"` or `id`) active this step. |
| `activeNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Node ids active this step. |
| `animate` | `boolean` | Glide nodes to new positions between steps. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `badges` | `object` | Small value at each node's corner: distance, degree, rank. |
| `dimEdges` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed edge keys. |
| `dimNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed node ids. |
| `directed` | `boolean` | Draw arrowheads. Default false. — fixed across steps |
| `direction` | `TB` or `BT` or `LR` or `RL` | Dagre rank direction. Default TB. — fixed across steps |
| `edgeColors` | `object` | Base color per edge key — tree vs back edges in a DFS. |
| `edges` | `array` of `object` | `{from, to, weight?, label?, id?, style?, color?, animated?, bidirectional?}`. |
| `flow` | `down` or `up` | Layered layout: "up" draws edge targets on top (child → parent pointers). — fixed across steps |
| `groups` | `array` of `object` | Labelled containers behind their members: `{id, label?, nodes?, parent?, color?}`. |
| `height` | `number` | Canvas height in px. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightEdges` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted edge keys. |
| `highlightNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted node ids. |
| `layout` | `force` or `layered` or `circular` or `grid` or `dagre` | Placement for nodes without x/y. "dagre" for architecture and flow diagrams, "layered" for DAGs and trees, "circular" for small dense graphs. — fixed across steps |
| `nodeColors` | `object` | Base color per node id. |
| `nodeSize` | `number` | Node diameter in px. Default 36. — fixed across steps |
| `nodeSpacing` | `number` | Dagre: gap between nodes in a rank, px. Default 36. — fixed across steps |
| `packetDuration` | `number` | How long an untimed packet takes to cross its edge, ms. Default 900. — fixed across steps |
| `packets` | `array` of `object` | Dots travelling along edges: `{edge, t?, label?, reverse?}`. |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Labels beside nodes: `{id, label, color?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `rankSpacing` | `number` | Dagre: gap between ranks, px. Default 52. — fixed across steps |
| `shape` | `string` | Default node outline: circle, box, person, cylinder, queue, pill, cloud, … — fixed across steps |
| `width` | `number` | Canvas width in px. — fixed across steps |
| `zoomable` | `boolean` | Wrap in a zoom / pan viewport. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```graph id=bfs layout=layered caption="BFS from A"
directed: true
nodes:
  - {id: A}
  - {id: B}
  - {id: C}
  - {id: D}
edges:
  - {from: A, to: B}
  - {from: A, to: C}
  - {from: B, to: D}
  - {from: C, to: D}
badges: {A: 0}
steps:
  - note: "Start at A, distance 0"
    activeNodes: [A]
  - note: "Visit A's neighbours at distance 1"
    activeNodes: [B, C]
    dimNodes: [A]
    activeEdges: ["A->B", "A->C"]
    badges: {A: 0, B: 1, C: 1}
  - note: "D is reached at distance 2"
    activeNodes: [D]
    dimNodes: [A, B, C]
    activeEdges: ["B->D"]
    badges: {A: 0, B: 1, C: 1, D: 2}
```
````

### kiwi-steps

A mermaid diagram walked one step at a time: focus and dim nodes, reveal sequence messages, highlight code in lockstep.

A bare `kiwi-steps` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `diagram`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-kiwi-steps`, `widget:kiwi-steps`, `steps`, `mermaid-steps`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `diagram` | `string` | Mermaid source. Unchanged across steps. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `caption` | `string` | Caption under the diagram. — fixed across steps |
| `dim` | `array` of `string` | Node ids to fade this step. |
| `focus` | `array` of `string` | Node ids to emphasise this step. |
| `kind` | `flowchart` or `sequence` | Detected from the diagram's first line; set it only to override. — fixed across steps |
| `messages` | `number` | Sequence diagrams: show the first N messages. Defaults to one more per step. |

````markdown
```kiwi-steps id=write-path caption="A write through the pipeline"
diagram: |
  flowchart LR
    A[Client] --> B[Storage]
    B --> C[Git commit]
    C --> D[Index update]
    D --> E[SSE broadcast]
steps:
  - note: "The client PUTs a page"
    focus: [A]
    dim: [C, D, E]
  - note: "Bytes land on disk — files are the source of truth"
    focus: [B]
    dim: [D, E]
  - note: "The commit makes the version addressable"
    focus: [C]
    dim: [E]
  - note: "Indexes are derivative, so they come last"
    focus: [D, E]
```
````

### list

A linked list: reversal, cycle detection, LRU chains, random pointers. A numeric `next` is how you draw a cycle back into the middle.

A bare `list` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `nodes`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-list`, `widget:list`, `linkedlist`, `linked-list`, `kiwi-linkedlist`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `nodes` | `array` of `object` | `{value, next?}`. `next` omitted or `true` means the following node, `false` means null, a number means that index — a cycle. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIndex` | `number` | Index of the active node. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed indices. |
| `doubly` | `boolean` | Draw a backward arrow beside each forward one. — fixed across steps |
| `edges` | `array` of `object` | Arcs over the chain: `{from, to, label?, side?: "above"\|"below"}` — random pointers, child links. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted indices. |
| `nodeWidth` | `number` | Node width, px. — fixed across steps |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Named pointers: `{index, label, color?}` — `slow`, `fast`, `prev`, `curr`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `showNull` | `boolean` | Draw a null terminator. Default true. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```list id=floyd caption="Floyd's cycle detection"
nodes:
  - {value: 1}
  - {value: 2}
  - {value: 3}
  - {value: 4}
  - {value: 5, next: 2}
steps:
  - note: "slow and fast both start at the head"
    pointers: [{index: 0, label: slow}, {index: 0, label: fast}]
  - note: "slow moves one, fast moves two"
    pointers: [{index: 1, label: slow}, {index: 2, label: fast}]
  - note: "fast has entered the cycle"
    pointers: [{index: 2, label: slow}, {index: 4, label: fast}]
  - note: "They meet inside the cycle — there is one"
    pointers: [{index: 3, label: "slow,fast"}]
    activeIndex: 3
    breakpoint: true
```
````

### map

Hash slots, chains and probe paths: hash tables, caches, symbol tables, routing tables, or a plain unordered dictionary.

A bare `map` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `slots` or `entries`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-map`, `widget:map`, `hashmap`, `hashtable`, `kiwi-hashmap`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeKey` | `string` or `number` | The key being inserted or looked up this step. |
| `activeSlots` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Slots being written this step. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `capacity` | `number` | Slot count. Defaults to `slots.length`. |
| `dimSlots` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed slots. |
| `entries` | `array` of `object` | `{key, value?}` for `mode: "map"` — a frequency map, a seen-set. |
| `hashOf` | `object` | Key → slot, shown as an `h(k)=i` badge. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightSlots` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted slots. |
| `mode` | `chain` or `open` or `map` | How to draw it: "chain" for buckets, "open" for open addressing with tombstones, "map" for an unordered dictionary. Inferred from `slots` / `entries`. — fixed across steps |
| `probePath` | `array` of `number` | Slots visited in order, numbered above the row. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `showIndices` | `boolean` | Index captions under the slots. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `showLoadFactor` | `boolean` | Show α = n/m. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `slots` | `array` | One entry per slot: `null` empty, `"DEL"` a tombstone, `{key, value?}`, or a list of those for a chain. |
| `slotWidth` | `number` | Slot width, px. Default 54. — fixed across steps |
| `tombstones` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Slots holding a tombstone, if not already `"DEL"`. |
| `why` | `any` | Slot index → explanation, revealed on select. |
| `widgetId` | `string` | Name for the inspect bus, for cross-widget linking. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```map id=probe caption="Linear probing into a full-ish table"
mode: open
capacity: 8
hashOf: {apple: 3, mango: 3}
slots:
  - null
  - null
  - null
  - {key: apple, value: 1}
  - null
  - null
  - null
  - null
steps:
  - note: "h(mango) = 3, but slot 3 is taken by apple"
    activeKey: mango
    activeSlots: [3]
    probePath: [3]
  - note: "Probe forward: slot 4 is free"
    activeKey: mango
    activeSlots: [4]
    probePath: [3, 4]
  - note: "Inserted. α = 2/8 — plenty of headroom"
    slots:
      - null
      - null
      - null
      - {key: apple, value: 1}
      - {key: mango, value: 2}
      - null
      - null
      - null
```
````

### matrix

An index-addressed table: DP tables, grids, adjacency matrices, confusion matrices. Cells take `[r, c]` or `"r,c"`.

A bare `matrix` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `values` or `layers`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-matrix`, `widget:matrix`, `grid`, `kiwi-grid`, `dp`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `activeCell` | `array` or `string` or `object` | The cell being written this step. |
| `activeCells` | `array` or `string` or `object` | Cells being written this step. |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `arrows` | `array` of `object` | Dependency arrows between cells: `{from, to, label?, dashed?}`. |
| `cellColors` | `array` of `array` | Base color per cell. |
| `cellSize` | `number` | Cell size in px. Defaults to 44, shrinking for wide tables. — fixed across steps |
| `centerRows` | `boolean` or `string` | Ragged mode: `"start"` for a staircase, `"center"` for a pyramid. — fixed across steps |
| `colHeaders` | `array` | Captions per column — the characters of a string, item weights, bit place values. |
| `colPointers` | `array` of `object` | Column labels above the table: `{col, label, color?}`. |
| `dimCells` | `array` or `string` or `object` | Dimmed cells. |
| `empty` | `array` of `string` | Strings that render as unfilled slots, e.g. `["."]`. |
| `flash` | `boolean` | Pulse cells whose value changed since the previous step. Default true. |
| `heatmap` | `boolean` or `object` | Shade numeric cells by value. `true` uses the table's own min/max. |
| `highlightCells` | `array` or `string` or `object` | Secondary highlight. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `layer` | `number` | Index of the slice to show. Readers can still click the tabs. |
| `layers` | `array` of `object` | Slices of a 3-D table as tabs: `{label, values}`. The shown slice replaces `values`. |
| `mask` | `string` or `array` | `"lower"` or `"upper"` to grey out the unused triangle, or an explicit cell list. |
| `path` | `array` | A traceback path drawn as a line over the cells. |
| `pathColor` | `string` | Color of the traceback path. — fixed across steps |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `readCells` | `array` or `string` or `object` | Cells the active cell reads from — diagonal, above, left. |
| `readColor` | `string` | Color of cells read by the active cell. — fixed across steps |
| `roundCells` | `boolean` | Circular cells instead of squares, for coin and token grids. — fixed across steps |
| `rowHeaders` | `array` | Captions per row. |
| `rowPointers` | `array` of `object` | Row labels right of the table: `{row, label, color?}`. |
| `showIndices` | `boolean` | Show row and column indices. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `sublabels` | `array` of `array` | Small caption under each value — a choice arrow, a parent pointer. |
| `tooltips` | `array` of `array` | Hover text per cell. |
| `values` | `array` of `array` or `string` | Rows of cell values. Rows may differ in length (ragged / triangular). `null` is unfilled, ±Infinity shows ∞, booleans show T/F. |

````markdown
```matrix id=lcs caption="Longest common subsequence of ABC and AC"
rowHeaders: ["", A, B, C]
colHeaders: ["", A, C]
values:
  - [0, 0, 0]
  - [0, 1, 1]
  - [0, 1, 1]
  - [0, 1, 2]
steps:
  - note: "Characters match: take the diagonal and add one"
    activeCells: [[1, 1]]
    readCells: [[0, 0]]
    line: 4
  - note: "No match: carry the better of above and left"
    activeCells: [[2, 2]]
    readCells: [[1, 2], [2, 1]]
    line: 6
  - note: "Match again — the answer is 2"
    activeCells: [[3, 2]]
    readCells: [[2, 1]]
    path: [[3, 2], [2, 1], [1, 1]]
code: |
  for i in range(1, n + 1):
      for j in range(1, m + 1):
          if a[i-1] == b[j-1]:
              dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
          else:
              dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
lang: python
```
````

### numberline

A single value axis: inequalities, interval arithmetic, binary-search-on-answer buckets, SLO thresholds. Closed endpoints are filled, open ones hollow.

A bare `numberline` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `min` or `max`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-numberline`, `widget:numberline`, `number-line`, `kiwi-number-line`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `max` | `number` | Right end of the axis. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `min` | `number` | Left end of the axis. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Ids drawn in the active color. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed ids. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted ids. |
| `includeNumbers` | `boolean` | Print the number under each tick. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `intervals` | `array` of `object` | `{from, to, fromOpen?, toOpen?, label?, color?, row?}`. Overlapping intervals stack. |
| `label` | `string` | Axis caption. — fixed across steps |
| `marks` | `array` of `object` | Dashed reference lines: `{at, label?, color?}`. |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Named pointers above the axis: `{at, label, color?}` — `lo`, `hi`, `mid`. |
| `points` | `array` of `object` | `{x, label?, style?: "closed"\|"open"\|"cross", color?, id?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `rays` | `array` of `object` | `{at, dir: "left"\|"right", open?, label?}` — an inequality with no far end. |
| `scale` | `linear` or `log` | Axis scale. `"log"` needs a positive `min`. — fixed across steps |
| `step` | `number` | Tick spacing. Omit for automatic nice ticks. — fixed across steps |
| `sweep` | `number` | Position of a sweep cursor. |
| `sweepLabel` | `string` | Caption beside the sweep cursor. |
| `ticks` | `array` of `number` | Explicit tick values, overriding `step`. |
| `width` | `number` | Canvas width, px. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```numberline id=bsearch caption="Binary search on the answer: narrowing [1, 32]"
min: 0
max: 32
step: 4
label: capacity
steps:
  - note: "The whole range is still feasible"
    intervals: [{from: 1, to: 32, label: "candidates"}]
    pointers: [{at: 1, label: lo}, {at: 32, label: hi}, {at: 16, label: mid}]
  - note: "16 works — discard everything above it"
    intervals: [{from: 1, to: 16, label: "candidates", toOpen: false}]
    pointers: [{at: 1, label: lo}, {at: 16, label: hi}, {at: 8, label: mid}]
  - note: "8 is too small — the answer is in (8, 16]"
    intervals: [{from: 8, to: 16, fromOpen: true, label: "candidates"}]
    pointers: [{at: 9, label: lo}, {at: 16, label: hi}]
```
````

### plane

A coordinate plane in data units: geometry, sweep lines, hulls, vectors, tile maps. Draws what it is given — the algorithm stays in the steps.

A bare `plane` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `points` or `segments` or `polygons` or `circles` or `vectors`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-plane`, `widget:plane`, `geometry`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Ids drawn in the active color. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `aspect` | `equal` or `auto` | "equal" (default) keeps circles round and right angles right. — fixed across steps |
| `axes` | `boolean` | Draw the axes through the origin. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `circles` | `array` of `object` | `{at, r, label?, dashed?}`. |
| `dimIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed ids. |
| `grid` | `boolean` | Draw the unit grid. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `height` | `number` | Canvas height, px. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted ids. |
| `labels` | `array` of `object` | Free text at a position: `{at, text, dx?, dy?}`. |
| `points` | `array` of `object` | `{x, y, id?, label?, style?: "dot"\|"open"\|"cross"\|"square", color?}`. |
| `polygons` | `array` of `object` | `{points: [...], label?, open?, fill?}` — a triangle, a hull being built. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `segments` | `array` of `object` | `{from, to, label?, arrow?, dashed?}`. Each end is a point id or a literal `[x, y]`. |
| `sweep` | `object` | `{axis: "x"\|"y"\|"angle", at, origin?, label?}`. |
| `vectors` | `array` of `object` | `{to, from?, label?}`. `from` defaults to the origin. |
| `width` | `number` | Canvas width, px. — fixed across steps |
| `xLabel` | `string` | Caption under the x axis. — fixed across steps |
| `xMax` | `number` | Right edge. Default 10. — fixed across steps |
| `xMin` | `number` | Left edge. Default 0. — fixed across steps |
| `xRange` | `array` of `number` | `[min, max]`, an alias for xMin/xMax. |
| `yLabel` | `string` | Caption beside the y axis. — fixed across steps |
| `yMax` | `number` | Top edge. Default 10. — fixed across steps |
| `yMin` | `number` | Bottom edge. Default 0. — fixed across steps |
| `yRange` | `array` of `number` | `[min, max]`, an alias for yMin/yMax. |

````markdown
```plane id=hull caption="Andrew's monotone chain, lower hull"
xMin: 0
xMax: 10
yMin: 0
yMax: 8
points:
  - {id: a, x: 1, y: 1, label: a}
  - {id: b, x: 3, y: 4, label: b}
  - {id: c, x: 5, y: 2, label: c}
  - {id: d, x: 8, y: 6, label: d}
  - {id: e, x: 9, y: 2, label: e}
steps:
  - note: "Sort by x, start the lower hull with a and b"
    polygons: [{points: [a, b], open: true, id: hull}]
    activeIds: [a, b]
  - note: "a→b→c turns clockwise, so b is not on the hull — pop it"
    polygons: [{points: [a, b, c], open: true, id: hull}]
    activeIds: [b]
  - note: "Lower hull is a, c, e"
    polygons: [{points: [a, c, e], open: true, id: hull}]
    highlightIds: [hull]
    dimIds: [b, d]
```
````

### plot

An x–y plot: complexity curves, predicate curves for binary search on the answer, latency against load, convergence.

A bare `plot` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `series`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-plot`, `widget:plot`, `chart-xy`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `series` | `array` of `object` | `{id?, label?, points: [{x, y}, …], kind?: "line"\|"area"\|"scatter", color?, baseline?}`, or `{expr: "sin(x) + a", samples?, domain?}` for a curve from a formula. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Series ids drawn in the active color. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `bind` | `object` | Values for the free names in an `expr` or a `when`, e.g. `{a: 2}`. Steppable, so a walkthrough can sweep a parameter. |
| `dimIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed series ids. |
| `guides` | `array` of `object` | Reference lines: `{x?, y?, label?, color?}` — an SLO, a threshold, a crossover. |
| `height` | `number` | Canvas height, px. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted series ids. |
| `marks` | `array` of `object` | Single annotated points: `{x, y?, label?, color?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `regions` | `array` of `object` | Shaded areas from a predicate: `{when: "y < x^2", label?, color?, opacity?, resolution?}`. `x` and `y` are in scope. |
| `shades` | `array` of `object` | Shaded bands: `{from, to, series?, fromY?, toY?, color?, label?}`. |
| `showAxes` | `boolean` | Draw the axes and frame. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | Draw the legend. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `width` | `number` | Canvas width, px. — fixed across steps |
| `xLabel` | `string` | Caption under the x axis. — fixed across steps |
| `xMax` | `number` | Right edge of the x axis. |
| `xMin` | `number` | Left edge of the x axis. Defaults to the data extent. |
| `xTicks` | `array` of `number` | Explicit x tick values. |
| `yLabel` | `string` | Caption beside the y axis. — fixed across steps |
| `yMax` | `number` | Top of the y axis. |
| `yMin` | `number` | Bottom of the y axis. |
| `yTicks` | `array` of `number` | Explicit y tick values. |

````markdown
```plot id=predicate caption="Binary search on the answer: the predicate flips once"
xLabel: capacity
yLabel: days needed
series:
  - label: days(capacity)
    points: [{x: 10, y: 15}, {x: 15, y: 10}, {x: 20, y: 7}, {x: 25, y: 6}, {x: 30, y: 5}]
guides:
  - {y: 7, label: "budget"}
steps:
  - note: "Too slow: 15 days exceeds the 7-day budget"
    marks: [{x: 10, y: 15, label: "lo"}]
  - note: "Fast enough — search left for a smaller capacity"
    marks: [{x: 20, y: 7, label: "mid"}]
  - note: "The smallest capacity that fits the budget is 20"
    marks: [{x: 20, y: 7, label: "answer"}]
    breakpoint: true
```
````

### queue

FIFO: BFS frontiers, work queues, sliding windows. `layout: ring` shows a circular buffer, where front and back crossing the end is the point.

A bare `queue` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `values`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-queue`, `widget:queue`, `ringbuffer`, `ring-buffer`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `values` | `array` | Slot contents. In `ring` layout this is the whole buffer, with `null` for an empty slot. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Slots active this step. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `back` | `number` | Index one past the tail — where the next enqueue lands. |
| `backLabel` | `string` | Label on the tail end. Default "back". — fixed across steps |
| `capacity` | `number` | Buffer size. Defaults to `values.length`. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed slots. |
| `empty` | `string` | Text shown when every slot is empty. — fixed across steps |
| `front` | `number` | Index of the head. Defaults to 0. |
| `frontLabel` | `string` | Label on the head end. Default "front". — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIndices` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted slots. |
| `layout` | `horizontal` or `ring` | Default horizontal. — fixed across steps |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Extra markers beside slots: `{index, label, color?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `radius` | `number` | Ring radius, px. Default 86. — fixed across steps |
| `showIndices` | `boolean` | Show slot indices. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `size` | `number` | How many slots hold data — what tells a full ring from an empty one. |
| `slotSize` | `number` | Slot size, px. Default 44. — fixed across steps |
| `title` | `string` | Caption above the queue. — fixed across steps |
| `why` | `any` | Slot index → explanation, revealed on select. |
| `widgetId` | `string` | Name for the inspect bus. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```queue id=ring layout=ring caption="A ring buffer wrapping past the end"
capacity: 6
values: [null, null, null, null, null, null]
front: 0
back: 0
steps:
  - note: "Empty: front and back coincide"
    size: 0
  - note: "Enqueue three; back advances"
    values: [a, b, c, null, null, null]
    back: 3
    size: 3
    activeIndices: [2]
  - note: "Dequeue two; front advances, the slots are not cleared"
    values: [a, b, c, null, null, null]
    front: 2
    back: 3
    size: 1
    dimIndices: [0, 1]
  - note: "Enqueue four more — back wraps past the end to slot 1"
    values: [g, h, c, d, e, f]
    front: 2
    back: 2
    size: 6
    activeIndices: [0, 1]
```
````

### sequence

A message sequence between participants: API flows, consensus rounds, handshakes, retries. Steps reveal one message at a time.

A bare `sequence` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `participants`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-sequence`, `widget:sequence`, `seq`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | `array` of `object` | `{from, to, label?, kind?: "sync"\|"async"\|"reply"}`, or `{note, over}`, or `{divider}`. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `participants` | `array` of `object` | `{id, label?, shape?, color?}` in left-to-right order. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `frames` | `array` of `object` | Grouping boxes: `{kind?, label?, from, to, color?}` — "alt [cache miss]", "loop". |
| `future` | `ghost` or `hide` | How to draw items after the active one. Default ghost. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `numbered` | `boolean` | Prefix each message with its number. — fixed across steps |

| `zoomable` | `boolean` | Wrap in a zoom / pan viewport. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```sequence id=cache caption="Read-through cache on a miss"
participants:
  - {id: C, label: Client, shape: person}
  - {id: A, label: API}
  - {id: R, label: Redis, shape: cylinder}
  - {id: D, label: Postgres, shape: cylinder}
items:
  - {from: C, to: A, label: "GET /page/42"}
  - {from: A, to: R, label: "GET page:42"}
  - {from: R, to: A, label: "(nil)", kind: reply}
  - {from: A, to: D, label: "SELECT …"}
  - {from: D, to: A, label: row, kind: reply}
  - {from: A, to: R, label: "SETEX page:42 60", kind: async}
  - {from: A, to: C, label: "200 OK", kind: reply}
frames:
  - {kind: alt, label: "[cache miss]", from: 3, to: 5}
steps:
  - note: "The client asks for a page"
  - note: "The API checks Redis first"
  - note: "Miss — nothing cached"
  - note: "Fall through to Postgres"
  - note: "Row comes back"
  - note: "Populate the cache, without blocking the response"
  - note: "Respond. The next read is a hit."
```
````

### table

A named-column table: relations, schemas, lock tables, Bayes 2×2, MVCC row versions. Cells are addressed `"rowKey.colKey"`.

A bare `table` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `columns`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-table`, `widget:table`, `relation`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `columns` | `array` of `object` | `{key, label?, pk?, fk?: {table, column}, align?, width?, type?}`. — **required** — fixed across steps |
| `rows` | `array` of `object` | One object per row, keyed by column `key`. — **required** |
| `activeCells` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Cells written this step, as `"rowKey.colKey"`. |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeRows` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Row keys active this step. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `arrows` | `array` of `object` | Cell-to-cell references: `{from: "r.c", to: "r.c", label?}`. |
| `caption` | `string` | Caption under the table. — fixed across steps |
| `deletedRows` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Rows removed this step, struck through. |
| `dimCells` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed cells. |
| `dimRows` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed row keys. |
| `highlightCells` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted cells. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightCols` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Highlighted column keys — the join key, the column being scanned. |
| `highlightRows` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted row keys. |
| `insertedRows` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Rows added this step, drawn green with a `+` gutter. |
| `maxHeight` | `number` | Scroll past this height, px. Default 420. — fixed across steps |
| `maxRows` | `number` | Render at most this many rows, then a "…n more" line. — fixed across steps |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `rowKey` | `string` | Column whose value identifies a row. Defaults to the `pk` column. — fixed across steps |
| `showIndices` | `boolean` | Unused; accepted so `table` and `matrix` bodies are interchangeable. — fixed across steps |
| `sort` | `object` | Sort indicator only: `{key, dir}`. Rows render in the order given. |
| `why` | `any` | Cell key → explanation, revealed when the reader selects it. |
| `widgetId` | `string` | Name for the inspect bus, for cross-widget linking. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```table id=orders caption="A write skew: both transactions read, then both write"
columns:
  - {key: id, label: id, pk: true, type: int}
  - {key: user, label: user_id, fk: {table: users, column: id}}
  - {key: total, label: total, align: right, type: numeric}
rows:
  - {id: 1, user: 7, total: 42.00}
  - {id: 2, user: 7, total: 19.50}
  - {id: 3, user: 9, total: 8.25}
steps:
  - note: "T1 scans user 7's orders"
    highlightCols: [user]
    highlightRows: ["1", "2"]
  - note: "T2 inserts another order for the same user"
    insertedRows: ["4"]
    rows:
      - {id: 1, user: 7, total: 42.00}
      - {id: 2, user: 7, total: 19.50}
      - {id: 3, user: 9, total: 8.25}
      - {id: 4, user: 7, total: 30.00}
  - note: "T1's invariant no longer holds — this is why it needs SERIALIZABLE"
    activeCells: ["4.total"]
```
````

### timeline

Spans on a shared axis with named lanes and causal arrows: scheduling, lock handoffs, happens-before, isolation anomalies, log spans.

A bare `timeline` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `intervals`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-timeline`, `widget:timeline`, `gantt`, `schedule`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `intervals` | `array` of `object` | `{start, end, id?, label?, lane?, state?, color?}`. `start === end` draws a point event. `state` of "blocked" or "waiting" draws hatched. — **required** |
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Span ids active this step. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `dimIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed span ids. |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightIds` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted span ids. |
| `hoverPredecessors` | `boolean` | Hovering a span lights the happens-before cone behind it. — fixed across steps |
| `laneHeight` | `number` | Row height, px. Default 26. — fixed across steps |
| `lanes` | `array` of `string` | Named lanes in draw order, labelled in the gutter — `thread A` above `thread B`. |
| `links` | `array` of `object` | Causal arrows between spans: `{from, to, label?, dashed?}` — happens-before, woken by, lock handoff. |
| `marks` | `array` of `object` | Extra vertical marks: query points, event coordinates. `{at, label?, color?}`. |
| `max` | `number` | Right end of the axis. |
| `min` | `number` | Left end of the axis. Defaults to the data extent. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `showAxis` | `boolean` | Draw the axis. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `showLegend` | `boolean` | Draw a legend for the `state` values in use. — fixed across steps |
| `sweep` | `number` | Position of the sweep cursor. |
| `sweepLabel` | `string` | Caption beside the sweep cursor — usually the running counter. |
| `ticks` | `array` of `number` | Values to label on the axis. |
| `width` | `number` | Canvas width, px. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```timeline id=lock caption="T2 blocks on the row lock T1 holds"
lanes: [T1, T2]
hoverPredecessors: true
intervals:
  - {id: t1run, lane: T1, start: 0, end: 4, label: "UPDATE", state: holding}
  - {id: t1commit, lane: T1, start: 4, end: 5, label: COMMIT, state: running}
  - {id: t2wait, lane: T2, start: 2, end: 5, label: "waiting for lock", state: blocked}
  - {id: t2run, lane: T2, start: 5, end: 8, label: "UPDATE", state: holding}
links:
  - {from: t1commit, to: t2run, label: "lock released"}
steps:
  - note: "T1 takes the row lock"
    activeIds: [t1run]
  - note: "T2's UPDATE blocks — hatched, because it is doing no work"
    activeIds: [t2wait]
  - note: "T1 commits and T2 is woken"
    activeIds: [t1commit, t2run]
```
````

### tree

Binary, n-ary and keyed trees: BSTs, tries, recursion trees, heaps (`fromArray`), union-find forests (`parents`), B-tree pages (`keys`).

A bare `tree` fence renders as a widget when its body carries `root` or `roots` or `parents` or `fromArray`.

Also spelled: `kiwi-tree`, `widget:tree`.

| Key | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `activeColor` | `string` | Primary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `activeKeys` | `object` | Which key cells light inside a keyed page: `{nodeId: [keyIndex, …]}`. |
| `activeNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Node keys active this step. |
| `animate` | `boolean` | Glide nodes to new positions when the tree changes. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name. Defaults to a summary derived from the data. — fixed across steps |
| `arity` | `number` | `fromArray` children per node. 2 (default) for a binary heap. — fixed across steps |
| `badges` | `object` | Badge per node key — subtree size, the range a segment-tree node covers. |
| `dimNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Dimmed (already processed) node keys. |
| `edgeDirection` | `none` or `down` or `up` | Arrowheads on edges. "up" for parent pointers and union-find. — fixed across steps |
| `fromArray` | `array` | Build a complete heap from an array: ids are indices, children of `i` are `2i+1`/`2i+2`. Pair with an `array` fence and `link:` for the two-representation view. |
| `ghostEdges` | `array` of `object` | Edges that no longer exist, drawn dashed: `{from, to, label?}` — the old link after a rotation. |
| `hGap` | `number` | Horizontal gap between sibling subtrees, px. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightColor` | `string` | Secondary highlight color. — fixed across steps |
| `highlightEdges` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Child keys, or `"parent->child"`, whose edge lights up. |
| `highlightNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Secondary-highlighted node keys. |
| `keyCell` | `number` | Width of one key cell in a keyed page, px. Default 30. — fixed across steps |
| `link` | `any` | Widget whose keys correspond to these node ids, for linked highlighting. |
| `nextLinks` | `array` of `object` | Same-level arrows: `{from, to}` — next-right pointers, the B+-tree leaf chain. |
| `nodeColors` | `object` | Base color per node key, e.g. one per connected component. |
| `nodeSize` | `number` | Node diameter, px. — fixed across steps |
| `parents` | `array` or `object` | Parent pointers instead of nesting: `parents[i]` is the parent of `i`. Self, `null` or `-1` marks a root. Node keys are the indices or object keys. |
| `pointers` | `array` of `object` | Labels next to nodes: `{value?\|id?, label, color?}`. |
| `props` | `any` | Escape hatch for a widget prop whose name collides with a reserved key. |
| `prunedNodes` | `array` or `number` or `string` | Node keys the search abandoned — drawn dashed and struck through. |
| `root` | `object` | Nested node: `{value, id?, badge?, edgeLabel?, keys?, leaf?, left?, right?, children?}`. |
| `roots` | `array` of `object` | Several trees side by side — a disjoint-set forest, a trie split per letter. |
| `showEdgeLabels` | `boolean` | Show each node's `edgeLabel`. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `showNulls` | `boolean` | Dashed empty slot on the missing side of a one-child binary node. Default true. — fixed across steps |
| `vGap` | `number` | Vertical gap between levels, px. — fixed across steps |
| `withArray` | `boolean` | With `fromArray`: also draw the backing array beside the tree, highlights kept in step. Default true. — fixed across steps |

````markdown
```tree id=heap caption="Sift-down after popping the root"
fromArray: [1, 3, 2, 7, 5, 9]
steps:
  - note: "Pop the root; move the last element up"
    activeNodes: [0]
  - note: "9 is bigger than both children — swap with the smaller, 2"
    activeNodes: [0, 2]
    highlightNodes: [1]
  - note: "Heap property restored"
    dimNodes: [0, 1, 2]
```
````

## Reserved keys

Handled by the fence platform, never passed to the widget:

Top level: `steps`, `frames`, `code`, `lang`, `props`, `link`, `caption`, `title`, `id`, `clock`, `width`, `autoplay`, `loop`, `why`.

In a step: `note`, `line`, `next`, `label`, `breakpoint`, `duration`, `why`, `expect`.
